title: Plinth template
description: Declarative contract for a panel template. Source of truth for the shape; actions are validated against the domain's closed catalog.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema the template was created with.

theme.description: Overrides of the design tokens, as a flat map from a token path ('color.button.background') to a scalar. Only the shape is checked here; the token catalog decides which tokens exist, which may change and which values they accept.

background.description: A picture behind the buttons of a page, covering it. At the root it is the default of every page; on a page it replaces that default for the page. Only a template in a folder (with a template.yaml) can reference images.

image.description: A PNG or WebP: a path relative to the template's folder, like 'img/stone.png'.

action.description: Identifier resolvable by the catalog: 'app.*' for app actions, or a semantic game ID.

keys.description: Literal keys sent on a tap: one step ('m', 'shift+1') or a list of up to 16 steps fired in order. A step is 'mod+...+key' with shift, ctrl or alt as modifiers.

icon.description: A small PNG or WebP next to the label, or alone with hide_label: a path relative to the template's folder, like 'img/fire.png'. Not together with image, and not on the quit button.

hide_label.description: Hides the label from view; it stays the button's accessible name. Not on the quit button.

style.description: The button's own colours over the template's theme, as a flat map like theme: only color.button.background, color.button.text, color.button.border and color.button.pressed-background, each checked like in theme. Only on a page button: not in the sidebar and not on the quit button.

image.description: A PNG that fills the face of the button: a path relative to the template's folder, like 'img/fire.png'. Only a template in a folder (with a template.yaml) can reference images. Not together with icon, not in the sidebar and not on the quit button.
